description: J2000 ICRS RA/Dec to topocentric Alt/Az reference vectors for the free-polar-align Phase 0 exit criterion. Earth orientation (ut1_minus_utc_s, pm_x_arcsec, pm_y_arcsec) is measured IERS data and is an INPUT to the transform, not something the transform derives: it depends on the Earth's actual irregular rotation. Vacuum columns exclude refraction (pressure=0); refracted columns use the per-row atmosphere. Epochs are confined to the span where IERS publishes measured values. 150 deliberate grid rows + 150 randomized rows.
